policy: Labels must come from the original human/forum label, never from this project's rule engine. Every change here names the evidence commit that shows the original and the rule-derived value.

remove_rule_derived_labels.reason: training/relabel_ground_truth.py replaced the original rc_failsafe label with the rule engine's strongest finding (CORRECTIONS.md C8).

exclude_incidents_from_evaluation.reason: Former 'wild holdout'; rules were re-tuned on it (CORRECTIONS.md C5). Not present in the labelled cohort records; listed so it can never enter an evaluation split.
